recentItems.description:
AD 

The Mickey Mouse Clubhouse games are on! Join Mickey, Minnie, Donald Duck, and Pluto in this awesome racing competition. 

Available on Disney Jr. and Disney+ 
https://ondisneyplus.disney.com/show/mickey-mouse-clubhouse-plus

Watch the next Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+ video here: https://youtu.be/O-uyckHzfD4

Watch Mickey Mouse Clubhouse on Disney Jr.! And check out more videos with Mickey and friends here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL2m1vjiMH_hNCpsg3xislhfp9YO8qjFkM

Mickey and his pals welcome audiences back to the Clubhouse they know and love for all-new adventures, filled with games, songs, laughs, and, of course, handy-helping. Devoted fans will also find surprises in store for them, including a new level called the Laughing Loft, Minnie’s very own Clubhouse, and an adorable, new friend, Little Helper.

recentItems.title: Gracie's Corner Compilation! 🎹🎵 | Gracie Sings About Everyday Learning! | Disney Jr.
recentItems.description:
Watch the Gracie's Corner Season 2 compilation, "Learning Songs". One of the best ways to learn is through music! Join Gracie and friends for educational songs that make learning fun every day.

Featured songs:
00:00 Sight Words Song
04:05 Opposites Song
07:03: Money Song
09:57 Use Your Imagination

Watch the next Gracie's Corner video here: https://youtu.be/TA4GO-ESxJc

Available on Disney Jr. and Disney+
https://www.disneyplus.com/whats-on

Watch more Gracie's Corner here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL2m1vjiMH_hOQN2o0eWIeE4_Hx2FotN6X

Sing and dance along with Gracie and her friends and family in music videos from the award winning preschool series. Episodes feature remixed nursery rhymes and original educational songs with modern beats about ABCs, counting, self-love, and more. Join Gracie as she takes a fun imaginary journey with family and friends singing fun and empowering songs from various genres and cultures including hip-hop, reggae, R&B, Afrobeat, jazz, Latin music and more.
